meta.title: SnowWall for Mac: snow, rain and seasons on your desktop
meta.description: SnowWall draws snow, rain, petals and more across your Mac desktop. Flakes drift around your pointer and settle on your windows. Free, from the menu bar, with no permissions to grant.
meta.ogTitle: SnowWall: weather for your Mac desktop
meta.ogDescription: Snow drifts across your Mac, moves aside for your pointer and settles on your windows. Free on the Mac App Store.
meta.ogAlt: The words “Weather for your desktop.” with snow settled on the letters, on a night sky.

hero.title: Weather for your desktop.
hero.sub: Snow drifts across your Mac, moves aside for your pointer and settles on your windows. All from a snowflake in the menu bar.
hero.price: Free. SnowWall Pro is a one-time $14.99.

settle.title: It settles on your windows.
steps: Flakes drift away from your pointer.
They land on the top edge of the window in front.
Snow builds up along the bottom of the screen, and frost creeps in from the edges while you’re away.
settle.hint: Move your pointer through the snow.

seasons.title: Weather for every season.
seasons.lede: Snowfall and Rain come free. SnowWall Pro adds eight more, from a blizzard to a shower of confetti.
seasons.hint: Choose one to see it fall, here and at the top of the page.

christmas.name: Christmas
christmas.desc: Snow with a red and green sparkle.

glass.name: Rain on Glass
glass.desc: Condensation gathers and runs down the screen.

blossom.name: Cherry Blossom
blossom.desc: Pink petals on a spring breeze.

leaves.name: Autumn Leaves
leaves.desc: Warm leaves, turning as they fall.

ambient.title: Ambient Mode, when you step away.
ambient.body: Snow fills the screen with a clock over it. Any key or click brings your desktop back.

tune.title: Tune every flake.
tune.lede: Size, speed, wind, sway, color and how much snow falls. Try four of them here; the app has the rest.

behind.title: Over your windows or behind them.
behind.lede: Keep the weather over everything, or send it behind your windows, between the wallpaper and the desktop icons.
behind.mockLabel: SnowWall’s Interaction settings with the Keep Effects Behind Windows switch.

built.title: Built for the Mac.
built.lede: A real simulation, drawn on the graphics processor, that knows when to step back.

facts.title: Drawn with Metal
facts.body: Up to 10,000 particles at Ultra quality, simulated on the GPU. Nothing loops, because nothing is a video.

facts.title: Battery Saver
facts.body: A lighter quality setting for long days away from a charger.

facts.title: 30 fps in Low Power Mode
facts.body: It also drops to 30 frames a second when the Mac runs hot, and pauses while the display sleeps.

facts.title: All your displays
facts.body: Snow falls across every screen you connect.

facts.title: Reduce Motion, your way
facts.body: When Reduce Motion is on, stop the snow, slow it down or leave it running.

facts.title: Shortcuts and Focus
facts.body: Shortcuts actions, and a Focus filter that pauses the snow while a Focus is on.

facts.title: 16 languages
facts.body: English, Russian, Japanese, Arabic, Hindi and eleven more.

facts11.title: Pause from Control Center
facts11.body: A Control Center control stops and starts the snow without opening the menu.

facts11.title: Widgets
facts11.body: Desktop widgets show what is falling and switch it with a click.

facts11.title: Spotlight actions
facts11.body: Pause, resume or change the effect straight from Spotlight.

facts11.title: Describe a mood
facts11.body: On Macs with Apple Intelligence, describe a mood and SnowWall builds a preset for it.

private.title: Private by design.

items.title: No data collected.
items.body: No analytics, no crash reporting, no tracking. SnowWall makes no network requests of its own.

items.title: No permissions to grant.
items.body: It draws over your desktop without reading what is on it. No screen recording, no accessibility access.

items.title: No account.
items.body: Nothing to sign up for. Your purchase is between you and the App Store.

private.more: The details are in the privacy policy. It is short, because there is little to say.

pro.title: Free to start. Pro, once.
pro.lede: Snowfall and Rain are yours to keep and tune. SnowWall Pro opens up everything else with one purchase. No subscription.

faq.title: Questions.

items.a: Yes. Snowfall and Rain are free, with every setting, and you can save three presets. SnowWall Pro is a one-time purchase that adds the other eight effects, Ambient Mode, the visual effects, Ultra quality and unlimited presets. It is not a subscription.

items.q: I opened SnowWall. Where is it?
items.a: SnowWall has no window or Dock icon of its own. It lives in the menu bar as a snowflake at the top of the screen. Click it to pause, switch effects or open Settings.

items.q: Will it slow my Mac down or drain the battery?
items.a: It draws on the graphics processor, so it uses some energy. It pauses when the display sleeps and drops to 30 frames a second in Low Power Mode or when the Mac runs hot. For less, choose Battery Saver quality or lower the snowflake count.
No. SnowWall draws over the desktop without reading what is on screen. If macOS ever asks you to give it screen recording or accessibility access, don’t grant it, and please let us know.

items.q: Can the snow stay behind my windows?
items.a: Yes. Turn on Keep Effects Behind Windows in Settings, under Interaction. The snow then falls between your wallpaper and your desktop icons.
When Reduce Motion is on, SnowWall stops the snow by default. You can choose to slow it down instead, or to leave it running.

items.q: Which Macs does it run on?

items11.q: Can I pause it without the menu?
items11.a: Yes. Add SnowWall’s control to Control Center, or use the Pause action in Spotlight or Shortcuts.

faq.more: Something else? See Support, or write to support@snowwall.app.
